title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 2
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: A further volume of Blavatsky's Secret Doctrine, concerned with humanity's origins and spiritual development within Theosophical cosmology. Its comparative and speculative arguments reflect the intellectual and esoteric setting of the work.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB). Source text obtained from Project Gutenberg (https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/54488).
